name: OBS Studio
author: MIDImap development team
description: Run your stream from a MIDI controller: scenes, streaming, recording, clips, virtual camera, studio mode, audio faders, sources, filters, transitions and media, with on-screen menus and a Controls panel. Needs OBS 31.1 or later with its WebSocket server on.

host.title: OBS computer
host.description: The name or address of the computer running OBS. Use 127.0.0.1 for this computer.

port.title: Server port
port.description: The port shown in OBS under Tools, WebSocket Server Settings (4455 unless you changed it).

secrets.name: Server password
secrets.description: The password shown in OBS under Tools, WebSocket Server Settings. Not needed if authentication is turned off there.

permissions.description: Connect to the OBS WebSocket server selected in setup.
Read the saved server password to sign in to OBS.
Display OBS controls in the MIDI menu and the Controls panel.
Show brief on-screen confirmations, such as recording started or stream reconnecting. You can silence them in Settings.

actions.name: Switch scene
actions.description: Make the chosen scene the program scene in OBS.
